LintSettings.description:
`lungecuta lint`'s thresholds (09-agent-interface.md, Lint), each from the past projects'
review rules; `null` or `false` turns a rule off.

graphics_min_seconds.description: a graphics layer is on screen at least this long (text cards are readable)
graphics_min_seconds.title: Graphics Min Seconds

repeated_source.description: no source frame is shown by two layers (montage shots do not repeat)
repeated_source.title: Repeated Source

music_licence.description: every music file and sound in a comp carries a licence record
music_licence.title: Music Licence

sfx_vary.description: the same sound is not on two consecutive sound layers
sfx_vary.title: Sfx Vary

no_black.description: no comp frame has nothing on screen, a gap between cuts or a frame before the first, as when a cut on the first beat lands a frame in
no_black.title: No Black

new_image.description: a shot of a clip that repeats its images (measured by lungecuta repeats) starts on a frame where a new image begins
new_image.title: New Image
